product.name: Consumer Financing
product.description: Non-bank financing services that provide individuals with funding for personal purchases and expenses.

product.name: Installment Services
product.description: Installment-based payment plans that allow consumers to pay for eligible purchases over scheduled repayments.

product.name: Payment Services
product.description: Digital payment and transaction services supporting the settlement and repayment of consumer finance and installment obligations.

product.name: Financial Services
product.description: Technology-enabled financial services for consumers, including financing, payment, and repayment-related functions.

product.name: Accounting Services
product.description: Accounting-related functionality supporting the recording, tracking, or administration of financial transactions and obligations.
